separation.detail: Install Demucs, torch and torchaudio. The six-source checkpoint has not been installed.

basic_pitch.label: Basic Pitch
basic_pitch.summary: Fastest (1-4 s per minute); less accurate on real guitar.

riley.label: Riley guitar model
riley.summary: Most accurate on every test (acoustic .908, electric .902, One intro .873); reverb-aware. 10-30 s per minute.
riley.license: MIT (adapted into server/riley; checkpoint fetched on first use, ~100 MB)

gaps.label: GAPS (classical guitar)
gaps.summary: Classical guitar model; falls apart on distorted playing.

yourmt3.label: YourMT3+
yourmt3.summary: Best on acoustic (.917) but misses low notes on synthetic guitar; about a minute per minute.
yourmt3.license: Apache-2.0 (adapted into server/yourmt3; checkpoint fetched on first use, ~560 MB)
yourmt3.detail: YourMT3+ runs from server/yourmt3 and needs transformers 4.45.1 and einops: pip install -r server/requirements-transcription.txt. Its checkpoint (about 560 MB) downloads from huggingface.co/mimbres/YourMT3 the first time it is used.

transcription.detail: Requires Basic Pitch and ONNX Runtime; uses bundled nmp.onnx or FRETWORK_BASIC_PITCH_MODEL. Optional guitar backends (riley, gaps) stay off unless FRETWORK_TRANSCRIBER is set.

gpu.detail: No NVIDIA (CUDA) or Apple (MPS) graphics card is usable by this server.

instruments.name: Guitar
instruments.status: Experimental audio analysis; no physical fretting diagnosis.

instruments.name: Bass (4-string)
instruments.status: Experimental bass routing; low-register transcription needs real-instrument validation.

instruments.name: Piano / keyboard
instruments.status: Experimental polyphonic audio routing; pedal/expression grading, staff engraving and MIDI comparison are not implemented.

privacy: Selected excerpts uploaded only after consent. Temporary files deleted on deletion, expiry or clean shutdown.
